name: 60559 · Westmont, IL
findings: ZIP 60559 (Westmont) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60559 (Westmont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60559 (Westmont) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
